newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish official reserves seen at $18.8 bln in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Polish official reserves seen at $18.8 bln in 1997.

text.p: Polish official foreign reserves, held by the central bank, are seen rising $337 million to $18.833 billion in 1997, against an estimated rise of $3.53 billion this year, the 1997 budget draft said.
In 1995 official reserves grew almost $8.9 billion to $14.96 billion.
The budget draft, which assumes a deficit of 2.6 percent of gross domestic product, unchanged tax levels in 1997 and a 5.5 percent GDP growth, was submitted to parliament last week. @

But the final shape of the budget depends on the parliament's decision on 1997 taxes and the government signalled it would amend the draft and propose a 2.8 percent deficit if its planned moderate tax cuts won parliamentary approval.
